chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Ḥumayd ibn al-Muthannā, he said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام about a pregnant woman who sees one gush or two gushes of blood during some days, and during a month or two months. He said: That is bleeding; this does not prevent her from salat (prayer).

key_terms.الدَّفْقَةَ: a single gush or flow of blood
key_terms.الدَّفْقَتَيْنِ: two gushes or flows of blood

ai.seo_question: Does bleeding during pregnancy stop a woman from performing salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a pregnant woman who experiences slight bleeding. Imam al-Kāẓim عليه السلام states that such blood is merely bleeding and does not prevent her from performing salat (prayer), indicating it is not treated as menstruation in this case.
